source: Funding & Policy Watch dashboard, verified against primary sources

opportunities.opportunity_title: NIAID Investigator-Initiated Program Project (P01)
opportunities.note: Receipt 25 Sep 2026, then 25 Jan / 25 May thrice yearly to 2029. NIAID asks for program contact 15 weeks ahead, so January is the realistic target.

opportunities.opportunity_title: NHLBI Program Project (P01)
opportunities.note: Final receipt date on the current announcement, which expires 31 Oct 2026. Minimum three interrelated projects.

opportunities.opportunity_title: US Flu Vaccine Effectiveness Network
opportunities.note: Forecast record; NOFO expected around 30 Oct 2026. Universities eligible.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Expanded Surveillance for Pediatric Infectious Diseases
opportunities.note: Forecast record. Standardised prospective active surveillance of pediatric acute respiratory illness and gastroenteritis.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Clinical Research Network on Antimicrobial Resistance (UM1)
opportunities.note: Successor to the ARLG, now explicitly including fungal pathogens on CDC priority lists. Domestic entities only; clinical trial required.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Infectious Diseases Clinical Trials Network (UM1)
opportunities.note: Clinical Trial Evaluation Units plus a Network Coordination Center, with an explicit remit to advance early-career investigators.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Emerging Infections Network — Travel-Associated Infectious Diseases
opportunities.note: Universities eligible. Detection speed, burden, severity, diagnostics and outcomes in international travelers, feeding sentinel detection and outbreak response.

opportunities.opportunity_title: BARDA Broad Agency Announcement
opportunities.note: Standing to 2028. Three stages: pre-submission call with the AOI technical POC, then quad chart plus market research abstract and ROM, then invited full proposal. A TechWatch meeting first is strongly recommended.

opportunities.opportunity_title: DARPA BTO office-wide BAA and ERIS
opportunities.note: The office-wide BAA closes 30 Sep 2026 with no FY2027 successor yet posted; ERIS stays open to 2031 as the rolling, lower-friction channel.

opportunities.opportunity_title: ARPA-H Health Science Futures Mission Office ISO
opportunities.note: Rolling. Names 'revolutionary omics platforms that enable unprecedented spatial and temporal scales and resolution' as an area of interest. Solution summary and written ARPA-H feedback are mandatory before any full proposal; encouraged proposers then get 45 days.

opportunities.opportunity_title: ARPA-H Proactive Health Office ISO
opportunities.note: Rolling. Explicitly welcomes disease-specific proposals in infectious disease under prevention, sensing and early detection.

opportunities.opportunity_title: DTRA — Fundamental Research to Counter Weapons of Mass Destruction
opportunities.note: Standing BAA, Assistance Listing 12.351. The most natural non-DARPA DoD vehicle for host-directed antiviral and biothreat basic science.

opportunities.opportunity_title: NIAID Resource-Related Research Projects (R24)
opportunities.note: Shared resources benefiting already-funded high-priority NIAID projects. NIAID expects only 1–2 awards per year, so pre-submission program contact is essential.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Medical Countermeasures Against Radiological/Nuclear or Chemical Threats (U01)
opportunities.note: Standing announcement. Natural-history work, injury models, and biomarker and triage technology validation. Clinical trials not allowed.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Innovations in Low-Cost and Simplified Pathogen Sequencing Workflows
opportunities.note: Targets $1–10 per-sample sample-to-data cost for routine public-health sequencing of viruses, TB, malaria and bacterial pathogens. ~15 awards across three tiers.

opportunities.opportunity_title: MIRA (R35) for Established Investigators
opportunities.note: Single PD/PI. Requires an existing single-PI NIGMS R01-equivalent and 45% of total research effort; no other NIGMS research application may be pending simultaneously.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Bioengineering Research Grants (R01)
opportunities.note: Standing. For integrating engineering and quantitative approaches with biology where the primary novelty is methodological.

opportunities.opportunity_title: NIH Parent R01 (Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
opportunities.note: New applications 5 Oct 2026; renewals, resubmissions and revisions 5 Nov 2026. Standard cycles thereafter.

opportunities.opportunity_title: Early Immune System Development and Ontogeny (R01)
opportunities.note: Mechanisms of immune development in utero, neonatally and in early childhood, including local mucosal immunity. Foreign organizations eligible.

opportunities.opportunity_title: NIH Parent R21
opportunities.note: Two years, $275K direct total, no preliminary data required. NIAID does not accept the parent R21 in all program areas — confirm with the PO first.

opportunities.opportunity_title: FDA Broad Agency Announcement — Regulatory Science
opportunities.note: Open to academia. Freestanding concept paper, then freestanding full proposal. Past the date for guaranteed FY26 consideration; the FY27 BAA is expected around Nov 2026.

opportunities.opportunity_title: NSF BIO Core — Core Research in Biological Sciences
opportunities.note: Consolidates and replaces the DEB, IOS and MCB core programs. Proposals accepted anytime, no deadline; 250–300 awards anticipated from $280M.
